verdict.rationale: Firstbase offers registered-agent and compliance services handled by its own human staff/bookkeepers (firstbase-docs-1, firstbase-docs-7, firstbase-docs-9), not an AI agent or API-driven workflow that a user's own AI agent could operate to prepare filings autonomously. Probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI both 404, showing no machine-accessible interface for agent delegation (firstbase-probe-1, firstbase-probe-2). Missing for 10: any API/SDK/agent-integration surface, evidence of AI-agent compatibility, or documentation of minimal-human-input automated filing.
